name: Covenant Broken: The Fractured Cradle
theme: Post-Robot War / Tripartite Ideological Schism / Emergent Fourth Path
lore: In the toxic wake of the Silent Sundering, humanity's war against the machine collective ended in pyrrhic ruin. Three factions contest the remnants: The Iron Consensus, The Ashen Genesis, and The Chimera Nexus. There are no clean solutions—every action bears painful tradeoffs.
truth_standard: Survival demands painful discernment; blind adherence to any single extreme guarantees extinction.

locations.name: Scrap Hollow Bazaar
locations.description: A neutral, ramshackle bazaar and scavenger haven where the unaligned barter under uneasy truce.

locations.name: Glass Crags
locations.description: Smashed databanks and fused glass towers from orbital strikes; high salvage value, roaming feral drones.

locations.name: The Consensus Spire
locations.description: The gleaming, monolithic relay tower of the Iron Consensus. Cold, humming, perfectly orderly.

locations.name: The Ashen Cradle
locations.description: Underground bunker complex and organic crop-caves belonging to the Purifiers. Sullen, fiercely defended, low-tech.

locations.name: The Chimera Foundry
locations.description: Geothermal bio-mechanical forge where Synergists splice warmachine limbs onto volunteers.

locations.name: The Resonant Void
locations.description: The crater where the prime warmachine core detonated. Anomalous EM fields and cognitive whispers.
